summary: check rich-text editor JSON on the server against an allowlist
use_when: keep a Tiptap or ProseMirror document to permitted formatting: nodes, marks, attributes
cap text length, nodes and depth; collect tagged users
not_for: HTML sanitizing or escaping: it validates the editor's JSON tree, it does not turn it into HTML
enforcing the editor's content model: which node may sit inside which, and leaf rules, are not checked yet
converting a document to Markdown or plain text, or rendering it
